annotations.title: SEC red-flag alerts across the market

description: Answers "Did anything bad just get filed?", "Alert me to restatements, auditor changes or CEO departures" or "Which insiders bought stock today?". Alerts from new SEC filings across all public companies, most serious first: RED (8-K item 4.02 restatements, 3.01 delisting notices, 1.03 bankruptcies, NT 10-K late annual reports), AMBER (4.01 auditor changes, 1.05 cybersecurity incidents, 2.06 impairments, 2.04 debt triggers, 5.01 changes in control, NT 10-Q), GREEN (open-market insider purchases of $100K or more, from Form 4s) and INFO (5.02 leadership changes, 2.02 earnings releases, 1.01 agreements, 2.01 deals, 2.05 restructurings, 3.02 unregistered share sales). Each alert has the company, ticker, EDGAR acceptance time, items, a text excerpt for red and amber 8-Ks, the filing link and the paid call that reads it in full. Filter by `levels`, `types` or a `tickers` watchlist. Built for polling: pass the previous answer's `cursor` as `since` to get only new alerts, and check the free sec_alerts_peek first so you pay only when there is something new. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

levels.description: Only these levels: red (restatement, delisting, bankruptcy, late 10-K), amber, green (insider buying), info (earnings, leadership changes, deals). Default: all.

limit.description: How many alerts to return, most serious first, then newest (1-50, default 20).

since.description: Only alerts found after this time: pass the previous answer's `cursor` to get just what is new. Default: every alert in the store (about the last day).

tickers.description: A watchlist: only alerts for these tickers. Default: the whole market.

types.description: Only these alert types: bankruptcy, restatement, delisting_notice, late_annual_report, auditor_change, cybersecurity_incident, impairment, debt_acceleration, change_in_control, late_quarterly_report, insider_purchase, leadership_change, earnings, material_agreement, acquisition_or_disposal, restructuring, unregistered_share_sale. Default: all.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
